description: This file provides utilities for working with YAML files, including safe loading, dumping, and custom loaders that detect duplicate keys.

classes.name: YamlLoader
classes.description: A custom YAML loader that raises an error when duplicate keys are found in a mapping.

methods.name: construct_mapping(self, node, deep=False)
methods.description: Overridden method in YamlLoader that constructs a mapping and checks for duplicate keys, raising an assertion error if duplicates are found.

ctags.name: Dumper
ctags.pattern: /^    from yaml import CSafeDumper as Dumper$/

ctags.name: Dumper
ctags.pattern: /^    from yaml import SafeDumper as Dumper  # type: ignore[assignment, misc]$/

ctags.name: Loader
ctags.pattern: /^    from yaml import CSafeLoader as Loader$/

ctags.name: Loader
ctags.pattern: /^    from yaml import SafeLoader as Loader  # type: ignore[assignment, misc]$/

ctags.name: construct_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^    def construct_mapping(self, node, deep=False):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]$/
